name: io.github.BartWaardenburg/srcmap-mcp
title: Source Map Debugger
description: MCP server for source map debugging: fetch, inspect, lookup, and extract original sources from any production website

environmentVariables.name: SRCMAP_BINARY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the srcmap CLI binary (default: srcmap)

environmentVariables.name: SRCMAP_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Cache TTL in seconds (default: 300, 0 to disable)

environmentVariables.name: SRCMAP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: inspection, lookup, fetch (default: all)
